question: Which Ministry of the Government of India launched South Asia Distribution Utility Network (SADUN) which aims to modernise distribution of utilities in South Asia?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Power ministry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Power Ministry** of the Government of India launched the **South Asia Distribution Utility Network (SADUN)**.
 
• SADUN aims to **modernise the distribution of utilities** across South Asia.
 
• The initiative is a step towards enhancing the **efficiency and reliability** of power distribution in the region.
 
• It seeks to create a **collaborative network** among South Asian countries to share best practices and innovations in the power distribution sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Ministry of Power is responsible for the **development of electrical energy in India** and addresses issues related to **power generation, transmission, and distribution**.
 
• The Ministry also formulates policies and acts as a **catalyst **for the development of the power sector.
 
• India's power sector is crucial for the country's economic development, and modernizing the distribution network is essential for ensuring consistent and reliable power supply.
 
• Initiatives like SADUN are part of the broader goals to improve energy access and sustainability in the region.
